description: This file defines the BulkLeaveAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for bulk actions (approve, cancel, reject) on leave requests in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for processing bulk leave status updates, validation, and exception handling.

classes.name: BulkLeaveAPI
classes.description: API class for handling bulk leave actions such as approve, cancel, and reject in the OrangeHRM leave management system.

methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve a specific leave.
